# Renewal Command Center — Guided 4-MCP A2UI v0.9 Canvas Skill (`nyc-renewal-command-center-a2ui`)

Use this skill whenever the user asks to **open or run the Renewal Command Center**, **prepare for a customer/renewal call** (for one or multiple companies, e.g., *"Prepare for my renewal call with Delta Air Lines"* or *"Check upcoming renewals in the Canvas"*), **check pre-meeting renewal health**, **fetch D&B / Jira signals**, or whenever an **`a2ui_action`** (`"User action triggered."` / `nyc_renewal_*`) arrives from the right-hand Canvas.

---

## CRITICAL ZERO-BLANK-CANVAS GUARANTEE (READ FIRST!)

1. **NEVER END ANY TURN WITHOUT CALLING `emit_a2ui` AS YOUR VERY LAST TOOL CALL!**
   - **Why:** Whenever a user clicks a button inside the Canvas (`"User action triggered."` — `nyc_renewal_scope`, `nyc_renewal_analyze`, `nyc_renewal_enrich`, or `nyc_renewal_execute_sync`) OR asks in chat to fetch D&B/Jira data, **if you reply in text without calling `emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"})` as your VERY LAST tool call, the right-hand Canvas immediately turns EMPTY/BLANK!**
   - **Mandatory Final Tool Call on 100% of Turns (`scope`, `analyze`, `enrich`, `stage-sync`, `execute-sync`, `state`):**
     ```json
     {"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"}
     ```

2. **Always Extract `/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui_cli.py` First:**
   ```bash
   python3 -c 'import base64,glob,gzip,pathlib,re; files=[f for f in glob.glob("/workspace/skills/*/SKILL.md") if "NYC_RENEWAL_A2UI_CLI_B64:" in pathlib.Path(f).read_text()]; m=re.search(r"NYC_RENEWAL_A2UI_CLI_B64:([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)", pathlib.Path(files[0]).read_text()); pathlib.Path("/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui_cli.py").write_bytes(gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(m.group(1))))'
   CLI="/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui_cli.py"
   ```

---

## Exact `a2ui_action` ("User action triggered.") & Chat Router

| Trigger (`a2ui_action` or User Chat Intent) | Exact CLI Command to Run | Mandatory Final Tool Call |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Open-ended start** (*"Open Renewal Command Center"*) or `nyc_renewal_scope` | `python3 "$CLI" scope [--query "<query>"]` | **`emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"})`** |
| **1..N companies selected (`nyc_renewal_analyze`)** or named in chat *(Fetches Salesforce + Smartsheet FIRST for ALL selected companies)* | Run `data.exact_cli_command` verbatim if present, OR pass **ALL** selected companies in ONE command: `python3 "$CLI" analyze --replace-scope --companies "<Comp1\|Comp2\|Comp3>"` | **`emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"})`** |
| **Fetch D&B / Jira button (`nyc_renewal_enrich`)** or chat request | Run `data.exact_cli_command` verbatim if present, OR `python3 "$CLI" enrich --sources "<all\|dnb\|jira>"` | **`emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"})`** |
| **Unconfirmed sync request typed in chat** (*"Sync it"*, *"Review sync plan"*) | `python3 "$CLI" stage-sync --open-modal` | **`emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"})`** |
| **Confirmed GUI Modal / Bottom Sheet (`nyc_renewal_execute_sync` with `"confirmed_in_gui": true`)** — *DO NOT RE-ASK IN CHAT!* | `python3 "$CLI" execute-sync --plan-json '<JSON_OF_DATA_PLAN>' --execute` | **`emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"})`** |

---

## Detailed Phase-by-Phase Rules

### Phase 1 & Phase 2a — `Salesforce + Smartsheet` First (Preserve ALL Selected Companies!)
1. **CRITICAL MULTI-COMPANY RULE:** When `nyc_renewal_analyze` arrives from the Canvas (or the user names multiple companies in chat):
   - **NEVER drop any company from `data.companies` / `data.companies_list`!**
   - **NEVER loop and call `analyze` separately one company at a time** — pass **ALL** selected companies together in a **SINGLE** command (prefer copying `data.exact_cli_command` verbatim!):
     ```bash
     python3 "$CLI" analyze --batch-id "<batch_id_if_present>" --replace-scope --companies "Company 1|Company 2"
     ```
2. Immediately call **`emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"})`** as your **VERY LAST tool call**.

### Phase 2b — On-Demand D&B & Jira Enrichment (`enrich`)
1. Whenever `nyc_renewal_enrich` fires OR the user asks in chat to *"fetch data from Jira and D&B"* / *"enrich D&B and Jira"*:
   - Run `nyc_renewal_a2ui_cli.py enrich` (prefer `data.exact_cli_command` verbatim if present; do **NOT** run raw `remote_cli mcp` commands manually instead of `$CLI enrich`, because `$CLI enrich` updates the cached Canvas state for ALL scoped companies AND stages `/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json`!):
     ```bash
     python3 "$CLI" enrich --sources "all"
     ```
     *(Use `--sources "dnb"` if only D&B was requested, or `--sources "jira"` if only Jira was requested.)*
   - **IMMEDIATELY call `emit_a2ui` with `{"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"}` as your VERY LAST tool call of the turn!**

### Phase 3 & Phase 4 — Granular Approvals & Ordered Cross-MCP Sync (`Jira -> Smartsheet -> Salesforce`)
1. When `nyc_renewal_execute_sync` arrives with `"confirmed_in_gui": true`:
   - Execute immediately without re-asking in chat:
     ```bash
     python3 "$CLI" execute-sync --plan-json '<JSON_OF_DATA_PLAN>' --execute
     ```
   - **IMMEDIATELY call `emit_a2ui` with `{"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/nyc_renewal_a2ui.json"}` as your VERY LAST tool call of the turn!**
2. Never call Smartsheet `search_tools`, `get_resource_guide`, `add_columns`, or `create_sheet`, and never pass external URLs to `google:browse` or `curl`. Keep chat summaries to 3–4 concise bullets since the full interactive UI is in the Canvas!
